scope: Record external prerequisites and safe retry gates. This cache does not grant permission or prove host behavior.

retryOnlyWhen: A required capability becomes observably available or its permission state changes.
New same-run external evidence arrives for an evidence-dependent item.
The user explicitly requests a retry and the required gate remains intact.
doNotRepeatWithoutChange: Do not repeatedly start a host after its exact SDK gate fails before launch.
Do not repeat a denied CEF or ETW permission probe, and do not bypass the denial.
Do not treat an unobserved host, device, permission, or package identity as available.

lastCheck.method: Read the SDK list and the recorded GameSaveCenter-Run.cmd gate result.
lastCheck.result: Only SDK 9.0.302 was visible; the repository requires exact SDK 8.0.423, so the launcher stopped before build, install, and version validation.

retryWhen: SDK 8.0.423 becomes visible to dotnet in this checkout.
The user explicitly requests another gate attempt after arranging the required SDK.

capabilities.note: The exact SDK gate stopped before host launch; no plugin startup, rendering, theme, or version result was observed.
retryWhen: The exact SDK gate passes and the intended Playnite installation is available for the prescribed launcher.
The user explicitly requests the prescribed host gate with its prerequisites prepared.
